items.description: Consider the UK black F85/0-102 when two beans, eight profiles and paired milk drinks remove household friction. Article 6764549_UK was £649.99 on September 24, 2026.
items.bestFor: Shared households that will actually use two beans and several saved profiles
items.imageAlt: Melitta official front image of the black Barista TS Smart F85/0-102 with TFT display, dual-chamber hopper and external milk container

items.description: Shortlist the black Passione OT F53/1-102 when a 253 mm-wide body, direct milk drinks and a removable brewer matter more than capacity or profiles.
items.bestFor: One- or two-person households prioritising a narrow one-touch milk machine
items.imageAlt: Melitta official front product image of the black Passione OT F53/1-102 with TFT display and all-in-one outlet

items.description: Shortlist the current US Cafina CT8 for staffed or supervised high-volume service when a dealer can engineer the exact grinder, milk, instant, water, waste and electrical configuration.
items.bestFor: High-volume hospitality, convenience, workplace or institutional programs with trained daily operators
items.imageAlt: Melitta Professional official key visual of the current Cafina CT8 commercial superautomatic with stainless body and large touch display

items.description: Shortlist the current Cafina XT6 for a staffed or supervised site that needs a narrow commercial machine, broad one-touch menu and up to 250 drinks per day.
items.bestFor: Hospitality, workplace and institutional sites planning around roughly 250 drinks per day
items.imageAlt: Melitta Professional official key visual of the current Cafina XT6 commercial superautomatic with stainless cabinet and touch display

items.description: Shortlist the current Cafina XT7 when a 300 mm-wide commercial platform, paired-drink capacity and an engineered milk program fit the site.
items.bestFor: Hospitality and workplace sites that can design a deliberate two-step or integrated milk workflow by region
items.imageAlt: Melitta Professional official transparent product image of the current Cafina XT7 commercial superautomatic

items.description: Shortlist the US Lotus white CM 6360, material 11648190, when eight profiles, paired drinks, strong milk automation, a removable brewer and a compact 251 mm width matter enough to justify a premium.
items.bestFor: Milk-drink households that want paired one-touch service and eight profiles
items.imageAlt: Miele official front view of the Lotus white CM 6360 MilkPerfection with two milk drinks and glass milk container

items.description: Shortlist the exact US CM 7750, material 11106260, when three selectable bean containers, 10 profiles, paired milk drinks, CupSensor and unattended descaling solve real household conflicts.
items.bestFor: Households that keep regular, decaf and another bean ready without swapping hoppers
items.imageAlt: Miele official front view of the black CM 7750 CoffeeSelect preparing two layered milk drinks beside its glass milk container

items.description: The VertuoPlus is still an unusually easy way to move between short capsule drinks and larger coffees. Its motorized head, barcode-led brewing and movable tank make the routine welcoming.
items.bestFor: A household that values one-button coffee and changes serving sizes more often than it changes beans
items.imageAlt: Nespresso VertuoPlus capsule coffee machine with rounded motorized head

items.description: The stainless US ES601 brings a 25-setting conical grinder, built-in dose scale, assisted tamping, guided espresso, drip coffee, rapid cold brew and hands-free hot or cold froth into one station.
items.bestFor: Households that switch between espresso, drip coffee and chilled drinks
items.imageAlt: SharkNinja official image of the stainless Ninja Luxe Café Premier ES601 machine and included accessories

items.description: Shortlist the exact current NICR 695 when you want Nivona's three Aroma Balance profiles, a removable brewer, five saved recipes and a combined coffee-and-milk outlet without paying for the 7-series milk automation.
items.bestFor: Espresso, coffee and Americano drinkers who will use the three Aroma Balance profiles
items.imageAlt: Nivona official front render of the titanium CafeRomatica NICR 695 with central color display and combined coffee and milk outlet

items.description: Shortlist the exact NICR 825 when two milk drinks at once, a removable brewer, three Aroma Balance profiles and ten saved recipes solve real household problems. Its dial-led interface is older than the current NIVO 8000 platform, but the daily controls remain unusually direct.
items.bestFor: Two-person households that regularly request milk drinks together
items.imageAlt: Official Nivona regional store image of the stainless and chrome CafeRomatica NICR 825 dispensing two milk drinks

items.description: Shortlist the current US Musica reservoir model when forceful manual steam, simultaneous brewing and steaming, programmable volumetric buttons and a compact 32 cm cabinet solve your daily workflow.
items.bestFor: Milk-heavy homes that want commercial-style steam and simultaneous brewing
items.imageAlt: Espresso Outlet exact-model photograph of the Nuova Simonelli Musica reservoir machine on a counter

items.description: Shortlist the current black US Oscar II reservoir model when a compact 12-inch-wide body, 58 mm manual espresso, timed shot buttons and forceful steam solve a milk-heavy routine. WebstaurantStore displayed the exact black pour-over 110 V machine at $1,995 on September 24, 2026.
items.bestFor: Milk-heavy homes that want strong manual steam and simultaneous brewing in a narrow body
items.imageAlt: Nuova Simonelli official three-quarter view of the current black Oscar II espresso machine

items.description: Buy the original US Profitec GO when a 58 mm group, front PID with shot timer, visible brew pressure and top-access OPV matter more than simultaneous brewing and steaming.
items.bestFor: Espresso-first buyers who want PID temperature control and visible pressure without modifying a machine
items.imageAlt: Clive Coffee product image of the black original-generation Profitec GO espresso machine

items.description: Buy the current US Profitec Pro 400 when simultaneous brewing and steaming, a 228 mm-wide E61 body, three documented boiler-temperature modes and switchable preinfusion matter more than a shot timer or degree-by-degree display.
items.bestFor: Households making espresso and several milk drinks in one session
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love product image of the stainless Profitec Pro 400 heat-exchanger espresso machine

items.description: Buy the current Whole Latte Love-exclusive Pro 500 PID when a 2.0 L heat exchanger, E61 lever, simultaneous manual steam, front PID and automatic shot timer match the household better than independent dual-boiler control.
items.bestFor: Households preparing several cappuccinos or lattes in one session
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love product image of the current stainless Profitec Pro 500 PID with front display and modular portafilter

items.description: Consider the final North American Pro 600 Quick Steam revision only when its 0.75 L brew boiler, 1.0 L steam boiler, E61 group, direct PID control and spring-loaded joystick valves suit the station and the condition is documented.
items.bestFor: Buyers comparing a documented, serviceable used dual boiler with compact E61 proportions
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love product image of the Profitec Pro 600 Quick Steam Plus with E61 group and spring-loaded joystick valves

items.description: Consider the final North American Profitec Pro 700 when a 0.75 L brew boiler, 2.0 L steam boiler, E61 group, rotary pump and reservoir or direct-plumb flexibility suit a permanent espresso station.
items.bestFor: Buyers comparing a documented used rotary dual boiler for a permanent espresso station
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love three-quarter product image of the final-generation Profitec Pro 700 with E61 group, black gauges and rotary valves

items.description: Choose the current Profitec Pro 800 when spring-driven extraction is the reason for buying. Its 7.8 kg lever group, 3.5 L copper boiler, hidden PID, two water modes and drain option form a distinctive home station.
items.bestFor: Lever enthusiasts who specifically want a repeatable spring pressure curve and quiet extraction
items.imageAlt: Official Profitec product image of the current Pro 800 spring-lever espresso machine with walnut handles and pine-green boiler gauge

items.description: Alexia Evo is an espresso-first single boiler, not a heat exchanger and not a factory flow-control package. Model 0970-A-CEVO combines a 0.75 L boiler, E61 group, PID shot timer, 3 L reservoir and 58 mm accessories in a narrow stainless body.
items.bestFor: Espresso-first households making a few drinks per session
items.imageAlt: Espresso Outlet three-quarter product view of the Quick Mill Alexia Evo 0970-A-CEVO E61 single-boiler espresso machine

items.description: Andreja Premium Evo 0980P-A is a manual E61 heat exchanger built around a 1.8 L boiler, Sirai pressurestat, 3 L reservoir and 52 W vibration pump. It can brew and steam together, but the North American machine does not document a PID, shot timer, rotary pump or factory plumbing.
items.bestFor: Households making several espresso and milk drinks in one session
items.imageAlt: Espresso Outlet three-quarter product view of the current Quick Mill Andreja Premium Evo 0980P-A E61 heat-exchanger machine

items.description: Carola Evo 0960-A-CEVO-A is unusual by design: a 0.75 L PID single boiler, E61 group and shot timer with no steam wand. The current US machine adds a front display, adjustable standby, low-water code and accessible expansion valve while keeping the narrow reservoir-fed chassis.
items.bestFor: Straight-espresso and Americano drinkers who do not need integrated milk steaming
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill official three-quarter view of the current Carola espresso-only PID single-boiler machine

items.description: Orione 03000 combines a stainless body, 58 mm portafilter, side-access 1.8 L tank, pressure gauge and compact thermoblock in an unusually simple manual machine.
items.bestFor: Straight-espresso drinkers who want a compact stainless machine with simple manual switches
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill official three-quarter view of the current Orione compact stainless thermoblock espresso machine

items.description: Pippa combines a 0.45 L insulated brass boiler, 58 mm commercial-style portafilter, side-access 1.8 L tank, pressure gauge, external expansion-valve access and a multidirectional anti-burn wand in a compact stainless body.
items.bestFor: Espresso-first households that want a compact stainless machine and conventional 58 mm workflow
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill official front three-quarter view of the current Pippa compact single-boiler espresso machine

items.description: The current US QM67 Evo combines a 0.75 L brew boiler, 1 L steam boiler, PID with shot timer, E61 group, vibration pump, dual manometer and 3 L top reservoir in a narrow 11.25-inch body.
items.bestFor: Espresso and milk-drink households that need simultaneous brewing and steaming
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill QM67 Evo stainless dual-boiler espresso machine shown from the front and right side

items.description: The current Rubino 0981 combines a 1.8 L insulated heat-exchanger boiler, Quick Mill E61-style group, vibration pump with pulsor, 3 L reservoir, boiler-pressure gauge and simultaneous brewing and steaming in a body only 265 mm wide.
items.bestFor: Milk-drink households that want simultaneous espresso and steam in a narrow traditional chassis
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill official front three-quarter view of the current analog Rubino heat-exchanger espresso machine

items.description: The US Silvano Evo 04005-A-EVO-A combines a PID-controlled coffee boiler, separate steam thermoblock, two vibration pumps, 58 mm group, shot timer, brew-pressure gauge and side-loading reservoir.
items.bestFor: Espresso-first households that still make regular milk drinks and want to avoid single-boiler mode switching
items.imageAlt: Quick Mill official front view of the current Silvano hybrid espresso machine

items.description: The current US Vetrano 2B Evo 0995P-A-EVOLED combines a 0.75 L brew boiler, 1.4 L steam boiler, E61 group, PID with shot timer, rotary pump, 3 L reservoir and direct water plus drain capability.
items.bestFor: Dedicated espresso stations where a direct water line and drain can be installed with suitable treatment
items.imageAlt: Chris Coffee product photograph of the Quick Mill Vetrano 2B Evo espresso machine

items.description: The current North American Silvia Pro X combines a 0.3 L insulated brass coffee boiler, 1 L steam boiler, two PID controllers, 58 mm commercial-style brass group, pressure gauge, automatic shot timer and adjustable zero-to-six-second soft infusion.
items.bestFor: Espresso and milk-drink households that need both boilers ready at the same time
items.imageAlt: Seattle Coffee Gear product photograph of the current Rancilio Silvia Pro X espresso machine

items.description: The Silvia is still a convincing, serviceable single boiler for someone who wants to learn its thermostat rhythm.
items.bestFor: Hands-on owner who enjoys a repeatable temperature routine
items.imageAlt: Rancilio Silvia V6 espresso machine in stainless steel

items.description: Appartamento TCA improves the original concept with four boiler-pressure presets and a redesigned group, while retaining strong steam and a wonderfully direct interface.
items.bestFor: Milk-drink enthusiast who likes traditional lever workflow
items.imageAlt: Rocket Espresso Appartamento TCA heat-exchanger espresso machine

items.description: The Giotto Cronometro R combined a 1.8 L copper heat-exchanger boiler, 58 mm E61 group, rotary pump, tank or direct water, PID, hidden timer and dual gauges in Rocket's flared case.
items.bestFor: Used buyers who can inspect operation, scale history, leaks, voltage, serial and service access before paying
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love product photograph of the retired Rocket Giotto Cronometro R espresso machine

items.description: The Mozzafiato Cronometro R combined a 1.8 L copper heat-exchanger boiler, 58 mm E61 group, rotary pump, tank or direct water, PID, hidden timer and dual gauges in Rocket's straight-sided case.
items.bestFor: Used buyers who can inspect operation, scale history, leaks, voltage, serial and service access before paying
items.imageAlt: Whole Latte Love product photograph of the retired Rocket Mozzafiato Cronometro R espresso machine

items.description: Rocket R Nine One is a current 47.4 kg dual-boiler machine with a fully saturated group, permanent-magnet volumetric pump, five programmable pressure profiles, a manual paddle, touch display and reservoir or direct-water operation.
items.bestFor: Experienced espresso users who want to explore pressure manually, then save a repeatable curve for daily use
items.imageAlt: Seattle Coffee Gear product photograph of the current Rocket R Nine One espresso machine

items.description: ROK EspressoGC Black PLUS is a compact, non-electric dual-arm lever with a glass-composite brew chamber, standard basket, Smartshot basket, manual milk frother and ten-year limited US warranty. ROK USA listed this package at US$259 on September 25, 2026.
items.bestFor: One or two deliberate straight espressos where manual pressure is part of the appeal
items.imageAlt: Official product photograph of the current black ROK EspressoGC Black PLUS manual espresso maker

items.description: The North American Saeco Xelsis SM7685 remains unusually capable for a legacy one-touch machine.
items.bestFor: Households that want several saved milk and black-coffee recipes from one machine
items.imageAlt: Seattle Coffee Gear product photograph of a stainless North American Saeco Xelsis SM7685 superautomatic machine

items.description: The Great Britain Siemens EQ.9 Plus Connect s700 TI9573X9GB combines two bean containers, a 2.3 L water tank, colour display, baristaMode adjustments, Home Connect, oneTouch DoubleCup and automatic steam rinsing of the milk path.
items.bestFor: A UK household that genuinely needs two beans available without emptying one hopper
items.imageAlt: Siemens official product image used on the UK TI9573X9GB page for the EQ.9 Plus Connect s700

items.description: The UK and Ireland Siemens EQ700 Integral TQ717GB3 is built around a 5-inch iSelect display, integrated 0.7 L milk container, 2.4 L water tank, 320 g hopper, ceramic grinder, OneTouch DoubleCup, autoMilk Clean, coffeeWorld and Home Connect.
items.bestFor: A UK or Ireland household that values a large touch interface and many saved drinks
items.imageAlt: Siemens official product image of an EQ700 Integral automatic coffee machine with integrated milk container

items.description: Slayer Espresso Single Group is built around a patented needle valve, a saturated group, independent 1.1 L brew and 3.3 L steam tanks, a three-position actuator and a current rotary-vane pump.
items.bestFor: Experienced espresso users who want tactile needle-valve profiling and will document dose, yield, time and actuator timing
items.imageAlt: Slayer official photograph of the current Espresso Single Group machine in the standard black, silver and wood configuration

items.description: The current VBM Domobar Digital combines a 58 mm VBM 1961 thermosiphonic chromed-brass group, mechanical preinfusion, 0.5 L single boiler, OLED temperature control, pressure gauge and vibration pump in a body only about 22 cm wide.
items.bestFor: Espresso-first kitchens wanting a traditional 58 mm VBM group in a narrow body
items.imageAlt: VBM official three-quarter image of the current compact Domobar Digital espresso machine

items.description: The current factory-documented Domobar Super Analogica puts a 2 L heat-exchanger steam boiler, rotary pump, tank or mains-water feed, 58 mm VBM 1961 thermosiphonic group, mechanical preinfusion and double-scale pressure gauge into a 25 cm-wide body.
items.bestFor: Milk-drink households wanting simultaneous brew and steam from a compact-width traditional machine
